title: Pagination
description: Page navigation for long lists, in three button styles. A highlight slides to the page you pick.
pageTitle: Animated Pagination Component in 3 Styles | Lordicon

whenToUse.text: Use it for search results, tables, blog archives and product lists, where people need to know where they are and jump back to a page. Choose boxed, bare or labelled buttons to match your UI. A sliding highlight shows the current page clearly.
whenToUse.alt: Animated pagination in three button styles: highlight slides to the selected page

accessibility: Each pagination is a nav landmark labelled "Pagination".
The current page is marked with `aria-current="page"`.
Previous and Next buttons are labelled and disabled at the ends of the list.
The sliding highlight is hidden from screen readers and stops animating with `prefers-reduced-motion`.
